name: locale-switcher
title: Locale Switcher
description: An i18n-library-agnostic dropdown for switching between arbitrary locales with localized language labels.
docs:
## Overview

`locale-switcher` provides a compact, i18n-library-agnostic language switcher. The caller provides the current locale, available locales, and a change callback.

Pass the active locale through `locale`. Message overrides are keyed by arbitrary locale strings, so additional languages can be supplied with `messages={{ es: { ... } }}`. Exact locale keys such as `es-MX` take precedence over base keys such as `es`; English is the final fallback.

## Features

- Accepts any locale strings and delegates locale changes to the caller
- In-file English and French labels
- Optional message overrides
- Icon-only trigger with accessible screen-reader text

## Usage

```tsx
import { LocaleSwitcher } from "@/components/ui/locale-switcher";

<LocaleSwitcher
  locale={locale}
  locales={["en", "fr", "es"]}
  onLocaleChange={setLocale}
  messages={{ es: { title: "Idioma", es: "Español" } }}
/>
```
